measurement.sample_interval_clock: Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC, absolute nanoseconds on this host boot
measurement.sample_interval_scope: Start/end bracket collection of the resource sample; no GPU synchronization or instantaneous peak. External profiler clock alignment requires a matching clock or explicit anchor.
measurement.sampling_limit: Conservative sampled account, includes monitor RSS and whole GPU. Host W exemption requires contiguous complete smaps coverage; at most two retries per read and 64 failed walks per run, with failed snapshots preserved. Recovered reads enforce the physical cap but receive no stable-peak credit. Device W requires owner lifecycle. Shared host pages may be double counted. Allocation/retirement transitions have no joint-memory credit; phase/campaign deadlines and global GPU/free/swap/disk limits apply. Transient peaks and runtime allowance sufficiency remain unproven.
